answer: Unrepeatable answer challenge. Each identity must answer a fresh random challenge whose verifier derives from the last accepted block's transaction order, so agents cannot precompute or replay replies across clones. A correct answer emits a session lantern token binding that identity to that block only. Colluding attackers must supply a distinct valid answer per clone per block, and a single shared raven signature or reused thread invalidates every linked identity. Cost: one full inference pass per clone per block, all prior work discarded.
